title: On the Identification of Fair Auditors to Evaluate Recommender Systems based on a Novel Non-Comparative Fairness Notion
reasoning: The paper's entire focus is on algorithmic fairness and justice. It introduces a new fairness notion based on the philosophical principle of 'non-comparative justice' and proposes methods to evaluate systems and auditors based on this ethical framework. This is a deep, formal evaluation of ethics in algorithms, not a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section.
